object.name: evi.sinfold~
object.description: Unlike other evieve waveshapers, <o>evi.sinfold~</o> focusses on mid/high harmonics. By varying the @drive attribute clear tonal shifts are apparent. Can be driven hard with clean anti-aliased saturation.
object.discussion: This is based on an idea by jhno and Trond Lossius.

attributes.name: aa
attributes.description: 'aa' stands for 'Anti-Aliasing'. Select the type of anti-aliasing with this attribute. 0=2nd order antiderivative, 1=1st order antiderivative 2x oversampled, 2=1st order antiderivative 4x oversampled (the default).

attributes.name: drive
attributes.description: Drive the waveshaping input gain via a sine shaping function. A bit like a % 0..1.. up to 2 is pretty safe, up to 4 be careful (in terms of aliasing).

attributes.name: smooth
attributes.description: Optionally smooth the internal coefficients over this time in ms. Smoothing is an exact algorithm.
